mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_bookshelf (user_id, book_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_bookshelf WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.book_id, s.create_time, b.book_name, b.author_name, b.cover_url FROM user_bookshelf s LEFT JOIN book_info b ON b.id = s.book_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
